title: Privelto — Share the document. Keep the private details.
description: Remove personal information from PDFs, photos and scans on your own computer. Download Privelto, the new home of Anonimato, for Windows, macOS and Linux.
headline:
Share the document.
Keep the private details.
intro: Remove personal data, faces and signatures from PDFs, photos and scans. Your documents stay on your computer, from the first check to the final export.
docBody: The participant agrees to collaborate on the project. Please retain the project description when sharing this record.
demoStatus: Private details are visible in this fictional example.
demoDone: Selected details removed. The useful content remains.
mechanismBody: Covering text is not the same as removing it. Privelto removes selected content from the page and cleans recoverable document structures. It then checks the actual output before allowing you to save.
step1Body: Detect names, identifiers, contact details, faces and signatures. Add a manual mark wherever you need one.
step2Body: Compare the original with the real output preview. Keep or remove each finding. Automatic detection needs your judgment.
step3Body: Selected content is removed, document metadata is cleaned, and final checks run before saving. A failed check blocks the export.
downloadIntro: Choose your desktop package. No account or subscription required.
rename: Privelto is the new name of Anonimato. Upgrades keep the existing model profile. The portable archive stores its application data in a PriveltoData folder beside the program.
setup1: The first launch downloads the base AI models and local runtime (about 700 MB). Optional advanced models need several additional GB. Document processing stays local.
setup2: For offline computers, import a model pack prepared on another computer. Models are not included in these downloads.
setup3: These packages are not code-signed or notarized. Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper may show a warning. Review the source and checksum before installing; do not disable system-wide security settings.
setup4: The macOS package is for Apple Silicon. The Linux AppImage targets x86_64 and may need FUSE or extraction. CI installation checks cover specific runner environments, not every operating system configuration.
q1: Do my documents leave my computer?
a1: Document analysis, AI inference and export run locally in the desktop app. An internet connection is used to download models and the runtime. Offline model packs are available. This website has no document upload feature.
q2: Can I rely on automatic detection alone?
a2: No. Review every page, especially scans, handwriting and identifiers. Automatic detection can miss details. Output verification checks the selected information; it is not a guarantee that every sensitive detail was identified.
a3: PDFs and supported image formats, including JPG, PNG and TIFF. You can review scans, faces and signatures, and draw manual redaction areas.
a4: Yes. The app is open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Bundled libraries and AI models retain their respective licenses. There is no subscription or account required to use the desktop app.
q5: What language is the app in?
a5: Choose English, Spanish, Galician, French, German, Italian or Portuguese in the app header. The language preference is saved locally. Interface translations do not change the document text or the coverage of national identifier rules.
closing:
Keep the useful part.
Keep control of the rest.
footer: Local document redaction, with you in control.
privacyBody: This is a static download website. It does not ask for documents, create user accounts, use tracking cookies or load third-party analytics scripts. Fonts and page assets are hosted on this domain. The hosting server processes standard request information, such as IP addresses, URLs and browser headers, in access and security logs. Download requests are handled by this server. Clicking source or build links takes you to GitHub, which has its own privacy policy. If you email us, your address and message are processed to answer your request. Avoid sending confidential documents by email. The desktop app processes documents locally; first-run model and runtime downloads connect to their published distribution services. This page does not promise that automatic detection finds every sensitive detail.
requirementsIntro: Start with the base models. Advanced AI is optional and needs more memory and disk space.
reqWindows: Windows 10 version 1809 or later / Windows 11, x64. Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required: the installer can download it; portable users need to install it separately.
reqMac: macOS 15 or later on Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). This package does not cover Intel Macs.
reqLinux: Linux x86_64 with a graphical desktop. Packages are qualified on Ubuntu 24.04; other distributions need compatible system libraries. AppImage requires FUSE 2 or extraction.
reqMemory: Recommended: 8 GB RAM for base processing, 16 GB for large scans and batches. Memory use grows with document size. GPU acceleration is optional; base processing can run on the CPU.
reqStorage: Reserve at least 3 GB free for the app, base models and local runtime, plus room for working files and exports. Optional 4B models add about 3 GB; 8B models add about 6 GB.
reqAdvanced: Automatic selection budgets about 8 GB available RAM or 3 GB free GPU memory for 4B, and 16 GB available RAM or 7 GB free GPU memory for 8B. More headroom may be needed. GPU inference uses Vulkan on Windows/Linux and Metal on macOS.
reqPortable: Extract the whole archive into a writable folder, then launch Privelto. Keep the portable marker and PriveltoData together when moving it. No administrator rights, Python installation or subscription are needed. Operating-system and driver caches can still exist outside that folder.
reqOffline: The first launch downloads about 700 MB of base models plus the platform runtime. For an offline machine, import a model pack prepared on another computer. Documents are always processed locally.
